title: The tour
summary: 🪐 Tour on the title screen: a screensaver flight round the solar system.
text:
Tap 🪐 **Tour** on the title screen to put the menu away and fly round the solar system. Tap anywhere (or press any key) to bring the menu back; on a phone the screen stays on while it runs.

On its way it visits:

- **Planets and moons**, settling into a sunlit orbit over each, and now and then home
- **The whole system**, pulled far out over the star with every orbit drawn
- **The star**, a slow pass low over its churning surface, its streamers and prominences
- **The asteroid belt**, running along it with rocks streaming past
- **A comet**, alongside it with its tails in full flow
- **A giant's rings**, skimming just above them

The readout at the top says where you are. Without the Tour button, the title screen makes the same trips more slowly behind the menu.
